nome_jp: 渇望の悪魔龍 アスモシス
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may destroy any number of your other creatures. For each creature destroyed this way, your opponent chooses a card from their hand and discards it.
■ When this creature or one of your other creatures are destroyed, your opponent chooses one of their creatures and destroys it.

■ このクリーチャーまたは自分の他のクリーチャーが破壊された時、相手は自身のクリーチャーを1体選び、破壊する。
